title: ToDo Task Brief
description: One brief per To Do entry. The renderer turns this into the Word document; the yellow section is built from `brief`.

text.description: The raw To Do entry, verbatim. Never corrected.

notes.description: Anything already in the task's notes or description field, verbatim.

source.description: Microsoft To Do, Todoist or Manual.

list.description: The list or project the task lives in.

task_id.description: Task id or link, if known.

labels.description: Labels the task carried when it was captured, so a write-back can keep them.

task_type.description: Drives how deep the brief goes. Errand, purchase, person, reflection and unclear entries get a short brief and no Claude session.

title.description: Starts with an action word. Pattern: 'Verb the thing: scope'.

description.description: One or two sentences, then 'Outcome: ...' naming what will be produced.

status.description: Usually starts 'Waiting for ...' or 'Ready to start'.

calendar_date.description: A date, or 'Not supplied'. Never guessed.

context_heading.description: Two or three words ending in 'Context', e.g. 'Video Context'.

context.description: Short first-person paragraphs: what I noticed or meant, why it matters to me, what is not yet known.

actions.description: Information Needed and Next Actions. Item 1 starts 'Next action:'. The last item says what to produce.

tools.description: Tools, skills, agents and third-party apps. Only what helps.

rhythm.description: One-off, or how often to revisit (loop or schedule).

done_when.description: A check that can be shown as completion evidence.
